picks.headline: Vigloo Studio: an AI-native production platform for short-form microdramas
picks.rationale: Highest-novelty structural shift: an AI-native platform consolidating pre-to-post into one environment shows how episodic short-form content will actually get produced end to end.
picks.excerpt: Vigloo launched Vigloo Studio, an AI-native production platform built for creators of serialized short-form (microdrama) storytelling, consolidating fragmented pre-to-post workflows into a single environment for episodic drama creation. A concrete example of AI restructuring how short-form narrative content is produced end to end.

picks.headline: How Ted Season 2 blended AI face tools into a mainstream episodic VFX pipeline
picks.rationale: Credible production case study: an AI-driven Clinton head replacement in a mainstream show signals generative face tools moving into everyday episodic VFX work.
picks.excerpt: For Ted Season 2, the team blended AI, CG, real-time tools and digital environments, using Deep Voodoo's proprietary software to build a period-accurate Bill Clinton head replacement for Seth MacFarlane that captured speech and facial nuance beyond traditional CG. Shows how generative/AI face tools are entering mainstream episodic VFX pipelines.

picks.headline: Clear Angle on scanning the future of VFX with LiDAR and Gaussian splats
picks.rationale: Insight into on-set data capture: ML-assisted LiDAR and Gaussian-splat scanning is reshaping how actors and environments are reconstructed in production.
picks.excerpt: Clear Angle Studios has become a key part of the modern VFX pipeline, capturing real-world actors and environments via LiDAR and Gaussian splats for teams to reconstruct in production. A look at how machine-learning-assisted scanning is reshaping on-set data capture for filmmakers and VFX artists.

picks.headline: Topaz Video, in depth: AI upscaling and restoration on a new subscription model
picks.rationale: Practical tool review: shows exactly how AI upscaling, noise reduction and de-interlacing fit real filmmaker and archival workflows now that Topaz has shifted to subscription.
picks.excerpt: An in-depth review of Topaz Video, the AI upscaling and restoration tool (noise reduction, de-interlacing, stabilization) now on a subscription model following Adobe's acquisition of Topaz Labs. Details how AI upscaling/restoration fits into real filmmaker and archival workflows.
